Thanks — it looks really nice, and I can see it saving links, sorting them, grouping them into collections, marking favorites, searching, and deleting. That part feels good.

But two things stop it from doing what I actually need, which is to *save and manage* my bookmarks:

1. **Saving doesn't pull in the link's info.** When I paste a web address, I expect it to figure out the page's title and a short description on its own, so I don't have to type them. Right now I have to type the title myself, and every new bookmark just gets the same generic line ("Saved to your personal library") and a "New" tag. I'd like it to fill in those details for me from the link (a stand-in/simulated version is fine — it doesn't need to really go fetch from the internet).

2. **I can't edit a bookmark after saving.** The only choice on a saved item is Delete. I need to be able to go back and fix a title, change its description, move it to a different collection, or adjust its tags. Without that I can't really *manage* what I've saved.

Could you address those two? The rest of what you showed is working for me.
